# Contributing to CodeCraft

Thanks for contributing to CodeCraft.

## Before you start

- Read the existing README and project structure.
- Keep changes focused on one problem.
- Prefer clear, maintainable code over clever shortcuts.
- Test the affected functionality before opening a pull request.

## Pull requests

Please include:

- A short summary of the change
- The reason for the change
- Testing performed
- Any follow-up work or known limitations

Keep pull requests small enough to review comfortably.
